scripts.build:win: vite build && powershell -Command "Expand-Archive -Path '$env:LOCALAPPDATA\electron\Cache\electron-v42.3.3-win32-x64.zip' -DestinationPath 'release\Планер-win32-x64' -Force; Rename-Item -Path 'release\Планер-win32-x64\electron.exe' -NewName 'Планер.exe'; Copy-Item -Path 'dist\*' -Destination 'release\Планер-win32-x64\resources\app\' -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item -Path 'electron\main.cjs' -Destination 'release\Планер-win32-x64\resources\app\electron\' -Force; Copy-Item -Path 'package.json' -Destination 'release\Планер-win32-x64\resources\app\' -Force; Compress-Archive -Path 'release\Планер-win32-x64\*' -DestinationPath 'release\Планер-windows.zip' -Force"
